context: Bind schema revision, migration inventory, and wrapper dependency/version with a static gate; cover CLI-ahead and DB-ahead disposable databases.
description: A CLI-ahead-of-hosted-DB skew can brick read-only tracker commands until migrate runs, obscuring authoritative state and encouraging stale fallback. Reproduce revision skew, choose an atomic CI/release guard rather than weakening unknown-schema write refusal, and require each schema bump to include migration plus deployment-order evidence.

preserves.behavior: Hosted DSN and tokens are never printed.
Writes against unknown revisions fail closed.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 tests/unit/scripts -k 'todo and (schema or migration or revision)' -q
verifications.expected: fails to detect an unpaired bump on the unfixed tree; exit 0 after guard

work_units.evidence: Disposable SQLite tests reproduce CLI-ahead and database-ahead rejection; direct migrate now rejects unknown newer revisions.
work_units.summary: Reproduce CLI-ahead and DB-ahead behavior with disposable databases

work_units.evidence: Decision recorded in _project/decisions/todo-schema-migration-atomicity-2026-08-01.md, including migrate-before-merge ordering and rejected alternatives.
work_units.summary: Record atomic guard and deployment ordering decision

work_units.evidence: Static inventory guard, wrapper binding, fail-closed migration change, and atomic rollback/skew regressions implemented; 40 focused tests pass.
work_units.summary: Implement revision migration inventory gate and skew tests

work_units.evidence: Required ci-paths job runs dependency-free todo_schema_migration_check.py on every develop PR; direct guard and workflow grep pass.
work_units.summary: Wire the guard into required CI in the same PR
